notes.title: Game update!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762901/0f200cb1235515e131c15e46a1eb3d5f1746fd0d.png[/img]

During the maintenance, the following changes were made to the game:

- Mistwood residents now have their own collections! Explore locations, exchange items, get more information about each resident!
- We also made some changes for a more comfortable game!

Enjoy the game!

notes.title: Game update!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762901/0f200cb1235515e131c15e46a1eb3d5f1746fd0d.png[/img]

During the maintenance, the following changes were made to the game:

- Improved the navigation system - now it's easier to find the target locations of the quest! 
- Expanded the functionality of the diaries - everything you need is at hand. 
- Updated the music and some sound effects. 
- Fixed the problem of mutual blocking of search items. 
- Made minor improvements to the interface for a more comfortable game!

Enjoy the game!

notes.title: Game update!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762901/0f200cb1235515e131c15e46a1eb3d5f1746fd0d.png[/img]

During the maintenance, the following changes were made to the game:

- Like a real reporter, Betty can put together a dossier on any resident of Mistwood! Now you can learn more about Lieutenant Carter by collecting pages from Betty's diary.

- We also updated the sound at locations and made some minor changes for a more comfortable game!

Enjoy the game!

notes.title: Game update!
notes.content:

Enjoy the game!

notes.title: Game update!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762901/0f200cb1235515e131c15e46a1eb3d5f1746fd0d.png[/img]

During the maintenance, the following changes were made to the game:

- Collections received in events are now always with you in a special section! Also updated sorting of story collections.

Enjoy the game!

notes.title: Game update!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762901/0f200cb1235515e131c15e46a1eb3d5f1746fd0d.png[/img]

During the maintenance, the following changes were made to the game:

▶️ At the request of the players, Floberg's Garage and Street Racers' Warehouse were returned to the previous version. Improved the operation of the spot in the mode.

▶️ We did not forget about fixing errors - it will now be more convenient to play.

Enjoy the game!

notes.title: Game update!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762901/0f200cb1235515e131c15e46a1eb3d5f1746fd0d.png[/img]

During the maintenance, the following changes were made to the game:

▶️ A new case is already waiting for Betty! And Ben Miller demands a sensation! Who is the whole city talking about: Who is it - a daring carjacker, a careless driver... Or is there something more behind all this?
▶️ New locations have appeared in the game and the location "Street Racer Garage" has been updated.
▶️ Due to the change in the location "Street Racer Garage", the mastering of players in this location will be reset.

Enjoy the game!

notes.title: Game update!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762901/d7f8c4a7a6e2f1033e5d97595b4b785358cfc75c.png[/img]

Mistwood residents are already looking forward to Christmas and New Year! A new event is already waiting in the wings! Also, more New Year's spirit was added, errors were fixed, and Christmas trees were installed. 🎄

Enjoy the game!

notes.title: Game update!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762901/d7f8c4a7a6e2f1033e5d97595b4b785358cfc75c.png[/img]

During the maintenance, the following changes were made to the game:

- Added a New Year's mood to the loading screen. 🎄
- The exit button is now available in the Settings screen.
- Also fixed some known issues and improved navigation for finding the necessary items for tasks.

Enjoy the game!

notes.title: Meet the update!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762901/629a1201c0c134cd297e8e7b5cd2086006e3c6a6.jpg[/img]

🔝U P D A T E🔝

• Improved interface.
• Added a new location entry window.
• A number of sounds have been updated.
• Improved game mechanics.

Some bugs have also been fixed to make the game even more comfortable!

notes.title: Meet the update!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762901/629a1201c0c134cd297e8e7b5cd2086006e3c6a6.jpg[/img]

🔝U P D A T E🔝

- Finalised the wardrobe and room entrance interface and made changes to the story prelude. Players who have progressed through the old version of the prelude and have not completed it will automatically be moved to the beginning of the First Case. 
- Updated quests are available for new players.
- And also fixed some bugs for an even more comfortable and fun game!

notes.title: Game update!
notes.content:
- The game has new modes: searching for a couple and a mirror room 
- The ability to change the mode has been added.
- Betty's wardrobe can now be opened anywhere on the map. And it can be added to many outfits! 
- Bug fixes - playing has become more convenient and enjoyable!
